Finding: 12 of 60 production changes reviewed had no Change Advisory Board (CAB) approval documented prior to deployment; all 12 were classified as emergency changes; 8 of 12 did not meet emergency classification criteria per the Change Management Policy
Root Cause: Emergency change classification is not formally gated; engineers can self-classify a change as emergency without manager review, bypassing CAB approval requirement
Recommendation: Define and enforce strict emergency change criteria; require VP-level sign-off for emergency classification; implement post-emergency CAB review within 24 hours of all emergency deployments

Finding: 5 changes deployed to production environments were identified in AWS CloudTrail with no corresponding change ticket in Jira - unauthorized deployments with no documented approval testing evidence or rollback plan
Population / Sample: CloudTrail events compared against Jira tickets / 100% comparison
Root Cause: Deployment pipeline does not enforce Jira ticket linkage as a prerequisite for production deployment; GitHub Actions workflows allow direct deployments without ticket validation
Recommendation: Integrate Jira and GitHub Actions to require valid change ticket number before production deployment workflow executes; alert Security team on any deployment without corresponding ticket

Finding: Change rollback procedures were not documented for 48 of 60 changes reviewed (80%); in the event of a failed deployment engineers have no predefined rollback steps
Root Cause: Change request template in Jira does not include a mandatory rollback procedure field; rollback planning is informal and undocumented
Recommendation: Update Jira change request template to include mandatory rollback procedure section; reject change requests submitted without rollback documentation; conduct rollback testing for all major releases

Finding: No post-implementation review (PIR) was performed for any of the 15 major releases deployed during Q1-Q2 2026
Root Cause: No formal PIR process exists; Engineering team treats deployment as the end of the change lifecycle; PIR is not referenced in the current Change Management Policy
Recommendation: Define and implement a mandatory PIR process for all major releases; schedule PIR within 5 business days of deployment; track outcomes in Jira and share summaries with Engineering Lead and IT Manager
